answer: Mechanism: costly per-identity judged work. Each identity gets a unique challenge every epoch (say, naming a raven, a lagoon and a hollow), and a randomly drawn jury grades it for originality. Rewards and voting weight require sustained good scores, so every fake identity must keep producing distinct, high-quality reasoning. Attacker cost grows linearly with the number of sybils, while reused or templated answers score zero and jurors who spot duplicates strip their standing.
